title: Driving in the Occupancy World: Vision-Centric 4D Occupancy Forecasting and Planning via World Models for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: 4D semantic occupancy plus 3D backward centripetal flow, forecast from multi-view camera history

control_signal.value: Ego action conditions: velocity, steering angle (as curvature), trajectory (next-step displacement), and high-level commands (go forward, turn left, turn right).

control_mechanism.value: Actions are Fourier-embedded, concatenated, projected by learned layers, and injected through conditional cross-attention with BEV queries in the autoregressive world decoder; ablation compares to additive embedding.

base_model.value: History encoder to multi-view BEV embeddings, memory queue with semantic- and motion-conditional normalization, autoregressive transformer world decoder; plus occupancy-based planner. No pretrained video backbone stated.

datasets.value: nuScenes, including nuScenes-Occupancy / OpenOccupancy-style annotations and the Cam4DOcc inflated occupancy and flow task.

metrics.value: mIoU (current, future, timestamp-weighted), VPQ for flow, L2 error and collision rate for planning.

controllability_evidence.value: Table 3 ablation: injecting conditions improves over the unconditioned baseline; a multi-condition row reaches future weighted mIoU 27.8 (+1.0) and VPQ* 35.0 (+1.5); predicted-trajectory row 28.1 and 35.1.

closed_loop.value: Partly: the planner's predicted trajectory is fed back as the next action condition for continuous rollout, but planning is scored open-loop on nuScenes. Rollout length not stated.

notes: Output is occupancy, not sensor video. Also an end-to-end planner; in controllable-generation mode the planner is discarded to avoid ego-status leakage. Limits passage did not contain an actual limitations section.
